==Description==
The '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' is an official Roblox toy that was released in July 2021. The toy contains the [[Engineer]], [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]], [[Mark II]] unit, [[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]], [[Sentry]] and Level 5 {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} [[DJ Booth]] from Hardcore Testing. When you buy the toy, one redeemable code is given, which allows you to get the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/758/The-Engineer The Engineer] bundle on Roblox. The toy is recommended for ages 6+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old.

==Official Description==
*'''From Jazwares website'''
*:"In BelowNatural’s Tower Defense Simulator, the zombie onslaught has begun and only you can stop them from destroying the world! Build towers and upgrade your defenses to withstand wave after wave of bigger and tougher enemies. Look out—here comes a boss!"

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $29.99-$34.99 in the US, £24.99 in the UK and €26.49 in the EU.

The stores in which you can buy the '''Roblox Core Pack - Tower Defense Simulator''' depends on country. The toy is subject to availability.

==Trivia==
*This toy contains the [[Mark II]] and [[Engineer]], despite them not being released in the game at the time.
**The [[Mark II]] driver is improperly called a ''Stun Trooper''.
**The appearance of the [[Engineer]] is different from the one seen in-game, since it closely resembles its unused version, featured in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XIreZxzrfyE TDS Content Reveal Trailer] from 20th of August 2020.
***The sentry included in this toy also resembles the [[Sentry]] tower, rather than the units. This is because the toy was based on the unreleased version of the [[Engineer]], which built sentries that used the [[Sentry]] tower's models.
*The toy contains two speakers, which are not present on the {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} [[DJ Booth]] skin.
**This is because the toy was likely based on the [[Hardcore Testing BETA]] appearance of the skin, which at the time used these speakers.
**The {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} [[DJ Booth]] is improperly called a ''Star Cat Singer''.
